questions.question_text:
Complete the statement.
The common factors of 24 and 45 are 1 and .............................................
Work out 2 \u00f7 0.04.

Expand.
x^3(x - 2)

Alex invests $200 at a rate of 2% per year simple interest.
Work out the total interest earned at the end of 4 years.

Didi buys 2 books at $b each and p magazines at $m each.
Find an expression, in terms of b, p and m, for the total amount Didi pays.

Rodrigo runs at an average speed of 10 km/h.
Work out the number of minutes he takes to run 5 km.

Roberta takes 1 hour 30 minutes to run 12 km.
Work out Roberta's average speed.

Each of 100 students records the time taken to walk one kilometre. The cumulative frequency curve shows the results.
Find the median
Find the lower quartile
Find the number of students who took more than 20 minutes to walk one kilometre.
Work out 3/11 \u00f7 1/2.

The interior angle of a regular polygon is 160\u00b0.
Work out the number of sides for this polygon.

The mean of five numbers is 7.
The five numbers are 3, 5, 10, 11 and x.
Find the value of x.

A, B and C lie on the circle centre O.
Work out the value of x.

Y is a point on the minor arc BYC.
Work out angle BYC.

Simplify fully.
\sqrt{20} + \sqrt{45} + \sqrt{80}

The triangles ABC and PQR are similar.
The area of triangle ABC is 24 cm^2.
PQ / AB = 1 / 2
Work out the area of triangle PQR.

x^2 + 18x + 2 = (x + p)^2 + t
Find the value of p and the value of t.

y varies inversely as \sqrt{x}.
When x = 4, y = 8.
Find y in terms of x.

cos x = -\sqrt{3}/2 and 0\u00b0 \u2264 x \u2264 360\u00b0.
Find the values of x.

log 4 + 2 log x = 2
Find the value of x.
